newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt farmer killed in militant-police crossfire.
newsitem.headline: Egypt farmer killed in militant-police crossfire.

text.p: A farmer was killed in his fields during a shootout between police and suspected Moslem militants in southern Egypt on Monday, security sources said.
They said police found Yacoub Kamal Boutros, 35, dead after an exchange of gunfire with two gunmen in the village of Mahari, near Abu Qurqas town in Assiut province.
Police in the village believe the men were members of the militant al-Gama'a al-Islamiya (Islamic Group), which is waging a low-level guerrilla war against security forces in southern Egypt.
More than 1,000 people have been killed in political violence in Egypt since 1992 when militants launched a bloody campaign to overthrow the government and set up a strict Islamic state.
